blocks.html: This was a class partner assignment where I took on the artist role. I used Unity's shadergraph mechanic to change the car colors to make efficient use of time and reduce the required amount of tilesheets.

items: Created a shader to randomize car colors
Developed a spawner that progressively created harder challenges over time
